$comment: JSON Schema for ideasim observed datasets. Place dataset files alongside this schema in data/datasets/.

description.description: Free-text description of data source and methodology

ideology_names.description: Canonical ideology names as they appear in observations

ideology_mapping.description: Maps dataset ideology names to simulation ideology names. E.g. {"social_democracy": "marxism"}. Omit if names match simulation directly.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata (source URL, version, date retrieved, etc.)

share.description: Fraction of ideological share [0, 1]. Shares at each year should sum to approximately 1.
